ac.title: IndexedDB Schema Initialization
ac.requirement: Database mp3_8d_sessions with sessions store, 4 indexes
ac.implementation: Constants and ensureIndexes() function create proper schema
ac.test: Database schema initialization test verifies store and indexes

ac.title: Session Start Capture
ac.requirement: Create session record when playback starts
ac.implementation: startSession() creates record with all required fields including timestamp, trackId, trackName, presetId, presetLabel, ritualUsed
ac.performance: Performance marks measure session start latency (lines 3034-3046)

ac.title: Session End Capture
ac.requirement: Calculate duration, update record on playback end
ac.implementation: endSession() calculates duration = (endTime - timestamp) / 1000, updates record with duration and endedManually flag

ac.title: Profile Data Clearing
ac.requirement: Clear sessions by profileId or all
ac.implementation: clearProfile() handles both specific profileId and 'all' cases
ac.ui-integration: clearProfileSessions() shows toast with deleted count
ac.test: clearProfile() functionality test covers both cases

ac.title: Error Handling and Graceful Degradation
ac.implementation: handleSessionError() with QuotaExceededError handling, user toasts, storage reset capability
